_about: STALL v1 (lane laneSTALL), STAGED, SHIPS OFF. The camp trader stall: a sell-only stall in the safe camp. Read by Scripts/Market/MarketCfg.cs (StreamingAssets first, then Assets/Data). Everything the player sees or can change is here: coins, prices, keys, layout, text, the camp rectangle, the combat rule. Sizes are px at hud.json referenceHeight (1080) and scale with HudCfg.Scale() (Screen.height / referenceHeight, clamped), the same UI scale as the HUD. Colours: the HUD palette (hud.json colors) is used for ink / dim / gold / frame / crimson / charcoal / shadow; only the panel rows are here. enabled=false = no stall, no prompt, no combat rule: the game is exactly as before.
_domNote: COINS HAVE NOTHING TO BUY YET. The stall is sell-only (Dom's brief): gear goes in, coins come out, and no system takes coins. Hooks are ready and OFF: rules.buyEnabled + ops 'buy' + rows with buyValue (a buy tab), sinks[] (camp upgrades, a toll), MarketLedger.TrySpend (future code spends coins with a request id). Decide what coins buy before this ships to players.

currency.name: Coins
currency._about: cap = the most the purse holds; a sale that would pass it is refused (wallet-full). Saved inside loot_save.json (version 2).

rules._about: sellRatio 0.33 = Armagedom's sell / buy ratio. sell = round(buyValue * sellRatio), at least minSell, never above buyValue (a check refuses a row that would pay more than it costs). ops: which orders the backend takes; 'buy' stays refused while buyEnabled is false. confirmSell: the first press arms the line, the second sells (gear is gone for good). listEquipped: worn items are listed greyed ('Worn') instead of hidden. keepRequests: how many request ids are remembered (dedupe).

rowsNote: One row per sellable item id. buyValue = what the item would cost to buy (round(5 * (6 armor + 5 poise + 1 weight)) to 5, from gear.json; PLACEHOLDER balance). sellOverride > 0 pins the sell price. sellable false = the trader refuses it. An id with no row is not bought. Re-generate with gen_market.py.

sinks.needs: a consumable or a gear row with a buyValue, rules.buyEnabled true, ops += buy, a Buy tab (not drawn today)
a permanent upgrade list (Armagedom has stamina and magazine upgrades); MarketLedger.TrySpend takes the coins

anchor._about: zones.json spot stall_1 of the camp (laneHUB rows B, camp at world offset 72). With the zone data merged, MarketZoneBridge reads the spot; x / z here are the fallback and what the checker compares. y comes from the player.

area._about: The camp rectangle in world x / z (zone_plan hub_camp: offset 72, boundaryLocal -4 -> z 68; limits.zMax 94). The stall and the no-fight rule work only inside it. Monsters are held outside by laneZONESPAN destSafe (followers stop 1.5 m before the door face z 63), not by this rectangle.

safe._about: The no-combat rule inside stall.area. refuse: the press ids that stay allowed (dodging and walking stay on); everything else (light, heavy, thrust, kick, specials, directed moves, riposte) and the guard hold are refused, one toast. Weapon lowered = the idle pose: no attack or guard can start, so the fighter stays in idle (no sheath clip is owned; hiding the weapon renderer is a Unity dev decision, laneHUB).

keys._about: KeyCode names (old Input Manager, like loot_ui.json). interact: E / pad X (same as the loot pickup). confirm: E / pad A. close: Esc / pad B / Tab / pad Start. up / down + the left stick move. The panel ignores the confirm press on the frame it opened.

colors._about: rows only; the rest is hud.json colors. [r,g,b(,a)] 0..1.

layout._about: px at the HUD reference height (hud.json referenceHeight). The panel is cut to the screen (margin) on a small window; rows scroll.
